subject: Your trial converts to a subscription in about 4 days
preheader: A plain heads-up before billing starts, with cancellation details.
headline: Heads up: billing starts when your 14-day trial ends.
body: No surprises: your TrueCap Pro trial converts to a paid subscription at the end of day 14. If Pro isn't earning its keep, cancel online from your profile in one click before then and you pay nothing.
If you stay, the subscription renews under the billing terms shown at checkout. You can review or cancel the plan from your profile before renewal.
Either way, the deals you've saved stay in your account — Free keeps them readable even if you downgrade later.
signature_note: Current billing and cancellation terms: usetruecap.com/terms
